feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 May 2026 6:11am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 30 May 2026 at 6:05am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic, driving a cold front across the area today.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 this evening occasionally 6 in central and western areas at first tonight, veering west or southwest 3 or 4 early tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time later.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches at times, rain spreading from the west this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or mist, occasionally very poor in fog patches


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest tomorrow afternoon


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers. Rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor later.
